sources: RIDB rec area 186 (East Sidney Lake), updated 2026-02-25
summary: USACE (Baltimore District) and RIDB confirm the recreation area is leased to and run by the Town of Sidney, with a campground, beach, picnic area, playground and boat launch, phone (607) 829-6006; the town's page confirms camping and gives 607-829-6433 for rates. No current page states site counts, hookups, rates, season for the campground, or how to book, so nothing written. USACE gives 'Memorial Day to Labor Day' for recreation generally, not for the campground.
flags: Stale website: https://www.eastsidneylake.org/ still shows the 2018 season ('2018 Season ... Open May 2018 thru September 12th 2018'; 'WE STILL HAVE A FEW MONTHLY AND SEASONAL CAMPSITES AVAILABLE FOR THE 2018 SEASON') and its rates page is '2018 SEASON RATES' with the prices blank. The operator's current page is the Town of Sidney's https://townofsidneyny.gov/?p=98 ('Our recreation area is open every day from 8:00 am to 8:00 pm ... To learn more about our rates and amenities, please call us at 607-829-6433'); USACE's page is https://www.nab.usace.army.mil/Missions/Dams-Recreation/East-Sidney-Lake/.

Phone: the entry's 607-829-6006 is USACE's and RIDB's number for the area; the Town of Sidney's current page gives 607-829-6433 for rates and amenities. Either may reach the park; the town's is the operator's.

Weak presence/inclusion: inclusion_evidence rests on the stale site plus Campendium. No current official page gives the number of RV sites, electric hookups, nightly rates or a booking method; the note's 'reservations online' is not supported by any page read (the town says to call). The 2018 site advertised monthly and seasonal campsites, so this may be mostly seasonal. Worth a call to 607-829-6433.
